class.name: SceneryModelPlacement
class.brief_description: A decoration model supplied by a [SceneryStreamingProvider].
class.description: An item of [constant SceneryStreamingProvider.CONTENT_MODELS]: a model drawn while its cell is supplied, registered with [method ModelRenderingServer.instance_register] and streamed by its own range. It is named by nothing, so no event or signal reaches it.

members.member: Its lights' colours, by name ([member ModelData.lights_colors]).
Its lights on or off, by name ([member ModelData.lights_state]).
The model's name, which its backend finds it by ([member ModelData.model]).
The distance it is drawn up to [m]; [code]0[/code] or less is no limit of its own (the streaming's draw distance).
The distance it is drawn from [m].
The model renderer's backend the model is the one of ([member ModelData.rendering_backend]); empty for the default one.
The model's replaceable materials, by number.
Where the model stands in the world.
